[ ABOUT ME ]

Development Philosophy

I am a Full Stack Developer who believes software should be simple, robust, and accessible to everyone. Whether I am modeling relational schemas in MySQL or crafting responsive interfaces in React, I focus on clean code and reliable performance. Outside of shipping code, I enjoy auditing web performance, exploring automated QA testing with Selenium, and learning modern backend architecture.
